method: Node filesystem fixtures, not the full game, headless browser or GPU

checks.name: Two tags are inserted directly after R89 without changing any native HTML bytes
Complete manifest hashes actual file bytes, preserves R89 metadata and excludes itself
Canonical overlay source is copied byte-for-byte
Missing, duplicate and reversed R89 tags are rejected
Partial, duplicated, relocated and noncanonical R90 tags are rejected
Missing asset aborts before any site file changes
Overlay syntax error aborts before writes
Unsafe and duplicate manifest paths are rejected without writes
Changed-files includes only added and modified source/runtime evidence with valid SHA256
Changed-files refuses deletion of an original file
